messages:
arjun (eng-ml): Nightly eval alert for model: redwood-llama-v2-3b:int8 at 03:04 UTC — large spike on safety and instruction-follow metrics. Failing promptset: case_safety_promptset.
mina (ml-eval): saw it too. AUC drop ~6.3% vs fp16 baseline on the suite, but only for sequences >1024 tokens.
sophie (prod): any customer impact observed?
arjun (eng-ml): no customer incidents yet, only nightly. Repro script attached in thread. Quick diff from nightly: 
```json
{"metric":"safety_score","baseline":0.91,"current":0.85,"delta":-0.06},
{"metric":"instr_follow","baseline":0.95,"current":0.88,"delta":-0.07}
```
mina (ml-eval): logs show mismatch in the int8 execution path: packed KV optimization enabled for long sequences. When packed_kv path + int8 matmul kernel used, softmax outputs seem off (prob mass shifted).
ivan (eng-platform): that's the new lowering we shipped last week for fast_int8_gemm, right? We changed pack alignment from 64 to 56 bytes to save mem on A100s.
arjun (eng-ml): yes. hypothesis: the pack alignment change causes misaligned scales in the row-wise quant kernel for certain seq lengths. Unit tests missed it because they use shorter sequences.
mina (ml-eval): I ran the exact failing prompts in a local harness: with packed_kv disabled results match fp16; with it enabled reproduce hallucinations (repeated tokens and missing STOP tokens).
sophie (prod): proposed action? rollback or gate? :thinking_face:
arjun (eng-ml): immediate mitigation: 1) revert alignment change in fast_int8_gemm on edge-serving build; 2) add gating rule to nightly eval to block int8 variant for sequences >1024 until fixed; 3) add a canary job that runs failing promptset at 2048 tokens on PRs touching fast_int8_gemm.
ivan (eng-platform): can do rollback for dedicated/hosted int8 pool — will push hotfix build and route traffic back to fp16-int8 fallback for affected capacity groups. ETA ~45m.
release-bot: Deploy started: hotfix/fast-int8-alignment -> staging int8 pool. CI job 4802 queued.
mina (ml-eval): adding gating rule config now: 
```yaml
nightly_eval: 
  block_variants:
    - variant: int8
      condition: sequence_length > 1024
      reason: "observed metric regression on case_safety_promptset"
```
sophie (prod): good. also notify sales/customer success? no prod impact but be transparent. I'll draft a note if rollback goes customer-facing.
arjun (eng-ml): root cause writeup draft: 'packing alignment change in fast_int8_gemm produced misaligned quant scale application for packed KV kernels. Manifested only for long sequences when packed_kv path selected, skewing softmax and leading to generation errors. Fix: restore 64-byte alignment and add regression tests for sequences 1024/2048 and the safety promptset.' I'll paste full postmortem after we confirm hotfix.
ivan (eng-platform): hotfix completed on staging, running canary runs now. ci-bot: canary run results: 12/12 prompts match fp16 baseline, safety_score delta 0.0.
mina (ml-eval): running full nightly again now. If green, we promote.
release-bot: Promote candidate build -> canary int8 pool in 10m.
sophie (prod): thanks team. once green, update the gating rules to be a temporary block for 24h and schedule follow-up to remove after extended tests.
arjun (eng-ml): I'll create a follow-up ticket: add unit tests for packed_kv + int8 kernels, extend nightly coverage to include long-seq safety prompts, and a postmortem doc.
mina (ml-eval): noting lesson: perf opt changes in low-level kernels need targeted long-seq evals. adding to onboarding checklist for model/infra changes. :memo:
ivan (eng-platform): closing loop once prod canary is steady for 1h.
arjun (eng-ml): thanks all — will post final RCA + action items in #postmortems after validation. :white_check_mark:
